Name: Cosmic Eye
Description: Your eye darkens under the influence of the eldritch madness, appearing as an endless starry sky. Make a ranged spell attack, on a hit this eye fires a projectile of eldritch energy that deals 1d8 necrotic damage. If you score a critical hit, you can reroll any roll of 4 or lower on the damage die until you get a higher result.
At Higher Levels: This spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
Sourcebook: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt
